measures.description: Count of invoices. Grain carrier for ar_aging with bill_outstanding.
measures.name: invoices_count

measures.description: Sum of invoice items_total (tax-inclusive, discount-applied). Sibling of quotation_amount.
measures.name: bill_amount

measures.description: Average invoice items_total.
measures.name: bill_amount_avg

measures.description: Cash Received: sums cash and bank receipt entries only; excludes discounts and other non-cash settlement. Amounts are unconverted per-bill journal totals — invoice.currency_code (the bill's own currency) is the correct filter/group-by guard.
measures.name: cash_received

measures.description: Receivable Settlement: sums cash received and approved non-cash reductions, including sales discounts. Amounts are unconverted per-bill journal totals — invoice.currency_code (the bill's own currency) is the correct filter/group-by guard.
measures.name: receivable_settlement

measures.description: Sum of invoice outstanding balances. Derived from unconverted per-bill journal totals — invoice.currency_code (the bill's own currency) is the correct filter/group-by guard.
measures.name: bill_outstanding

measures.description: Invoices with any balance owing (partially paid + never paid). Distinct from invoices_never_paid.
measures.name: invoices_unpaid

measures.description: Invoices with classify() UNPAID (balance equals amount — never paid).
measures.name: invoices_never_paid

measures.description: Past due >30 days AND still owing. Distinct from bills_past_due_date.
measures.filter_sql: days_past_due IS NOT NULL AND days_past_due > 30 AND outstanding > 0
measures.name: invoices_overdue_unpaid

measures.description: Sum of positive outstanding on invoices more than 30 days past due relative to the request Business Date (invoice.due_date). Distinct from invoices_overdue_unpaid.
measures.name: overdue_outstanding

measures.description: Due date has passed (app overdue-report meaning; no payment filter).
measures.filter_sql: days_past_due IS NOT NULL AND days_past_due >= 0
measures.name: bills_past_due_date

measures.description: classify() PAID — outstanding exactly 0.
measures.name: invoices_fully_paid

measures.description: classify() OVERPAID — outstanding negative.
measures.name: invoices_overpaid

measures.description: classify() PARTIAL PAID — both legs required (0 < balance < amount).
measures.name: invoices_partially_paid

measures.description: Sum of quotation items_total. Sibling of bill_amount.
measures.name: quotation_amount

measures.description: Count of current Open Quotation Snapshot rows. Historical quotation questions are unsupported because complete quotation history is not owned.
measures.name: quotations_open_snapshot

measures.description: Invoiced revenue = SUM(items_total) = Σ[(price·qty−discount)+(price·qty−discount)·tax/100]. Deliberately different from ledger_revenue (gross price×qty posted). Clarify bare "revenue" asks.
measures.name: invoiced_revenue

measures.description: Ledger revenue = Σ(credit−debit) on OPERATING_REVENUE/NON_OPERATING_REVENUE. Equals Σ(price×qty) from convert() posts; Sales Discount is OPERATING_EXPENSE so excluded. Sibling of invoiced_revenue — do not reconcile the two.
measures.name: ledger_revenue

measures.description: Orders whose computed_status is NEW or IN_PROGRESS (stored status not FINISHED/CANCELLED).
measures.name: open_customer_orders

measures.description: Count of all customer orders.
measures.name: orders_count

measures.description: Most recent customer_order.created_at (recency).
measures.name: customer_last_order_date

measures.description: Count of jobs / work orders.
measures.name: jobs_count

measures.description: Active Job Snapshot: jobs in IN PROGRESS, CREATED, SUBMITTED, or PENDING MOVE APPROVAL. Not created_at=today.
measures.name: active_jobs_count

measures.description: Finished-state (FINISHED or DELIVERED) jobs with no Effective Bill: neither a direct invoice nor the parent Customer Order invoice.
measures.filter_sql: status IN ('FINISHED', 'DELIVERED') AND effective_bill_id IS NULL
measures.name: jobs_finished_unbilled

measures.description: Count of customer records (snapshot: how many customers exist).
measures.name: customers_count

measures.description: Count of supplier records (snapshot: how many suppliers exist).
measures.name: suppliers_count

measures.description: Units sold on invoice lines (invoice_item resource — kind-locked).
measures.name: product_units_sold

measures.description: Units of product entered on job planning grids (work_order_items lines). The counterpart of product_units_sold (units invoiced). This is planned/entered quantity - NOT issued stock; the MATERIALS tab's issued-stock list (inventory_items) is not represented in this catalog.
measures.name: product_units_used

measures.description: Revenue on invoice lines via item_revenue (invoice_item resource — kind-locked).
measures.name: product_revenue

measures.description: All Receive inventory rows regardless of approval status.
measures.name: stock_receipts_recorded

measures.description: Receive rows that count toward on-hand stock (status=APPROVED).
measures.name: stock_receipts_approved

measures.description: Role-aware UI payment status is unavailable because Billing does not yet expose that truth explicitly. Not granted.
measures.name: invoice_payment_status

resources.description: Print job details and specifications on ai_v2_bq_job_print_fact.
resources.name: job_print

resources.description: Material lines PLANNED on a job's INFO-tab planning grid (work_order_items). NOT the MATERIALS tab, which shows issued stock from a different table (inventory_items) that this surface cannot see.
resources.name: work_order_item

resources.description: Journal rows ⋈ accounts. Deliberately NOT kind-scoped: bill_id is nullable (manual journals exist); a kind predicate would silently drop them and change what revenue means. Boundary is the account-type filter plus Financial Analytics grant.
resources.name: ledger_entry
